# Sol Next — Full Technical & Product Reference (v9.3.1-public, Build 931)

## 1. Executive Summary
Sol Next is an open-source (Apache-2.0), zero-cost Android & HarmonyOS AI personal assistant and autonomous mobile phone agent created by Zhang Chongyang (许昌北海医院张重阳). Built on a **100% zero-Python Full-Stack Rust 2024** foundation, Sol Next v9.3.1 combines:
1. A pure native Jetpack Compose Material 3 dual-mode experience (`Chat` + `Task`) with Light (`#FFFFFF`) and Obsidian Dark (`#0E0F11`) themes at up to 120Hz.
2. Mature cloud account authentication (PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 200k-iteration phone/email + password & native Google Sign-In) that automatically unlocks **free built-in DeepSeek** and **Brave Search** real-time web grounding, alongside 1-tap BYOK connection testing and OpenRouter PKCE OAuth.
3. **2026 SOTA 24kHz On-Device Neural Voice** bundled uncompressed inside the APK (GTCRN denoiser -> Silero VAD v5 -> X-ASR 160ms streaming Zipformer2 Transducer -> Kokoro v1.1 24kHz HD 103-voice bilingual TTS) with zero cloud voice API keys required.
4. **Extreme On-Device Compute Kernel (`libsol_kernel.so v600`)**: hand-written ARM64 NEON, DotProd (`sdot`), I8MM (`smmla`), and SVE2 inline assembly + 3 `spirv-val`-verified Vulkan 1.1 Compute Shaders + Android NNAPI NPU graph execution + Qualcomm QNN HTP / OpenCL probe.
5. **Background Independent 1:1 Virtual Display** with **Android 13 zero-MotionEvent Accessibility IME passthrough** (avoiding `InputDispatcher` keyboard focus-steal) and **Android 14–16 `DISPLAY_IME_POLICY_HIDE`**, bottom-right collapsed PiP with zero reply occlusion, and 3-tab AI Phone Call Suite.

## 2. Architecture Breakdown

### 2.1 2026 SOTA 24kHz On-Device Neural Voice Pipeline
Bundled directly inside `assets/sol_neural_voice/` (mmap zero-copy `noCompress`) and `lib/arm64-v8a/libsherpa-onnx-jni.so`:
- Stage 1: `denoiser/gtcrn_simple.onnx` (535 KB) — real-time neural speech enhancement and wind/road noise suppression.
- Stage 2: `vad/silero_vad_v5.onnx` (2.31 MB) — `<100ms` Voice Activity Detection and instant barge-in interruption.
- Stage 3: `asr/` — **X-ASR 160ms Streaming Zipformer2 Transducer** (161 MB, bilingual ZH+EN with punctuation, live Android 15 ARM64 `RTF = 0.20`).
- Stage 4: `tts/` — **Kokoro v1.1 24kHz HD** (200 MB, 103 voices, 24kHz studio-grade audio, ONNX XNNPACK `RTF = 0.701`, double-buffered prefetch, 3ms anti-pop fade, 4 curated voices with 1-tap preview).

### 2.2 ARM64 Assembly + Vulkan Compute + NPU Kernel (`libsol_kernel.so v600`)
- 16KB page-aligned Rust 2024 JNI library (`arm64-v8a` & `x86_64`) compiled by zero-dependency `rust/sol-builder`.
- Hand-written ARM64 inline assembly verified on Android 15 ARM64: `frameStats` (`3.50×`), `frameDiff` (`2.80×`), `resizeCrop` (`4.80×`), `q8Gemv` (`1.82×`), `cosineF32` (`6.04×`).
- 3 `spirv-val`-verified Vulkan 1.1 Compute Shaders (`frame_stats`, `frame_diff`, `resize_crop`), Android NNAPI NPU runtime graph execution, and QNN HTP / OpenCL hardware detection, benchmarkable live inside **Settings**.

### 2.3 Full-Stack Rust 2024 Backends (Zero Python)
- `sol-world-rs` (`tokio` + `axum 0.8` + `rusqlite` WAL): `16.7 MB` RSS (`150.7×` reduction vs legacy Python), `/health` `0.082ms` p50, hosting the 8-endpoint PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 cloud account center, zero-copy `206` Range OTA, and JEPA/MCTS/OmniHub endpoints.
- `sol-engine-rs` (`x86-64-v3` static-pie musl ELF): `3.66 MB` RSS, `1.76ms` cold search (`608×` faster), `8–10µs` hot LRU.

### 2.4 Security, Virtual Display & Cryptographic Verification
- **Rust Sealed Vault**: ChaCha20 + Encrypt-then-MAC HMAC-SHA256 + HKDF-SHA256 bound to package `ai.sol.next` and APK v2/v3 cert SHA-256 (`d7a6fed0ff42843a20329944f2b1741060048610546df6cf2ad8179cfe335478`). Zero plaintext keys in Git or APK.
- **Android 13 Zero-MotionEvent IME Isolation**: On `SDK_INT <= 33`, virtual-display input bypasses `InputDispatcher` via direct Accessibility `ACTION_SET_TEXT` / `ACTION_CLICK` / `ACTION_IME_ENTER`, preventing main-screen IME collapse.
- **Quality Gate**: 371/371 automated tests passing (`sol-core` + `app` + `sol-kernel` + `sol-builder`), `:app:lintVitalRelease` clean, 16KB page-aligned.
